verdict.rationale: Crossmint is developer infrastructure for wallets, payments, and agent payment rails, and nothing in the evidence describes a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product, such as a dashboard copilot. Agent Checkouts runs a narrow checkout agent through an API for developers' own agents, which is an adjacent feature, not an in-product assistant. The AI-assistants docs page only covers feeding the docs into external code helpers like Cursor or Copilot. Neither earns credit for this story.
